manuscript_claim: Native pixel-scale shifts increased error in matched synthetic parents.
metric_figure_or_table: Week 3 paired effects; final evidence ledger
limitations: Two scale values in one simulator and prior.
allowed_wording: The tested 0.04 and 0.06 arcsec/pixel conditions increased synthetic validation MAE.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Pixel scale is the dominant error source in real lens analyses.

manuscript_claim: Half exposure and doubled read noise increased synthetic validation error.
limitations: Synthetic observation/noise model; Gaussian PSF controls only.
allowed_wording: The tested exposure and read-noise changes increased error under this simulator.
prohibited_stronger_wording: The result calibrates HST detector noise or establishes PSF-family robustness.

manuscript_claim: Some tested source-position and source-size shifts changed error; fixed shear effects were inconclusive.
metric_figure_or_table: Week 5 paired effects and multiplicity table
limitations: One validated Sersic family and fixed interventions; no alternate mass family.
allowed_wording: Selected source-position/source-size shifts affected synthetic estimates.
prohibited_stronger_wording: These shifts characterize all source populations or real-lens caustic selection.

manuscript_claim: The fixed annulus ablation substantially increased error.
limitations: Artificial fixed-radius mask removes potentially useful lensed-source signal.
allowed_wording: The CNN depends on information in the tested image annulus.
prohibited_stronger_wording: The model uses an invalid causal shortcut.

manuscript_claim: The tested point-image baseline had weaker all-parent performance and fallbacks than the CNN.
limitations: Observation-only SIS/SIE geometry estimate; training-mean fallback; not pixel likelihood.
allowed_wording: The evaluated point-image pipeline underperformed on these synthetic conditions.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Classical Bayesian/pixel-likelihood modeling is generally inferior.

manuscript_claim: Two tested SIE equation/root paths produced closely matching predictions.
limitations: Shares source-light, PSF, noise, and preprocessing components.
allowed_wording: The implementations agreed for the tested equation/root/rasterization convention.
prohibited_stronger_wording: The model is independent of simulator or real-domain shift.

manuscript_claim: Targeted nuisance randomization improved fixed-validation performance.
limitations: Four tested synthetic nuisance factors and one randomized view per parent.
allowed_wording: Randomized training reduced MAE over the tested validation stress composite.

manuscript_claim: The randomized ensemble had lower paired MAE than the fixed comparator on the independent holdout.
limitations: Same synthetic prior/renderer; only five conditions; one exactly-once score.
allowed_wording: On this independent synthetic holdout, the randomized ensemble had lower paired MAE in the tested conditions.
prohibited_stronger_wording: The model accurately measures Einstein radii in real HST/CASTLES lenses.

manuscript_claim: CASTLES feature coverage is incomplete under the frozen observable comparison.
dataset_release: 137 processed observations from 69 lens systems; 1,400 synthetic views
limitations: Descriptive image/metadata proxies; no real labels or predictions.
allowed_wording: Pixel-scale overlap was weak and processed angular field coverage was unsupported under the stated rule.
prohibited_stronger_wording: The CASTLES comparison establishes model accuracy or a calibrated real benchmark.

manuscript_claim: The Week 9 CNN initializer showed no consistent evaluation-count speedup.
limitations: Observation-only point-image fit; optimizer cases only.
allowed_wording: No supported speed advantage was found for the tested point-geometry initializer.
prohibited_stronger_wording: CNN initialization is generally useless or slower in full lens modeling.
